transcription.text: Information technology allows organizations to store, process, and exchange data at a scale that has transformed work and public services. Digital systems can improve access to education, healthcare, and communication across long distances. The same systems create responsibilities around privacy, cybersecurity, reliability, and unequal access. Organizations need clear rules for who can use data and how failures are detected and corrected. Technology creates the greatest benefit when convenience and innovation are matched by security, accountability, and support for users.
